messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: streaming p99 latency for pool=dedicated-pool-3 (eu-west-1) breached SLO (> 2.0s). metrics: streaming_latency_p99=2.45s, p95=0.81s, queue_depth=320
anya: ack — I'm on it. Paging SREs and confirming customer-visible impact. @pagerduty-bot can you page the rotation?
pagerduty-bot: Paging: @anya (on-call) — incident triggered: STREAMING_P99_BREACH pool=dedicated-pool-3
miguel: I'm seeing autoscaler events delayed ~45s around ~3166667710..3166667755. Pool attempted to provision +6 slots; slot-ready handshake lag ~30–60s.
cheng: runtime logs show warmup tasks repeatedly failing due to KV-cache coldpath misses; new slots returning 503 on /health during init. Possible regression from last runtime kernel patch.
opsbot: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-tail-latency
opsbot: quick checks to run:
```
# queue depth
curl -s "http://internal-metrics/api/query?expr=queue_depth{pool=\"dedicated-pool-3\"}"
# check pod logs (example)
kubectl -n inference logs pod/dedicated-3-abc --tail=200
```
taylor: customer impact: a handful of high-throughput tenants reported retries and streaming stalls. Need an immediate mitigation (routing fallback or smaller model).
anya: applying temporary route change to shift 30% of heavy sessions to dedicated-pool-2 (warm) and fallback to quantized model for new connections. Applying now.
anya: `routeset apply --route streaming-prod --weight dedicated-pool-3=70,dedicated-pool-2=30`
miguel: after route change p99 dropped to ~1.6s within ~90s, p95 ~0.78s. queue_depth reduced to ~90. Partial mitigation confirmed.
cheng: hypothesis: autoscaler serializes warmups (parallel_warmups=1) so during bursts warmup tail blows out. New slots stuck in warmup due to repeated KV misses and runtime health check flakiness. Recommend increasing parallel_warmups and reducing warmup_timeout to fail faster.
miguel: proposed temporary autoscaler config patch to test:
```
{"min_slots":"2","max_slots":"50","warmup_timeout_s":"60","parallel_warmups":"4"}
```
anya: approved temporary rollback of the runtime kernel patch on canary to validate whether warmup failures stop; miguel to coordinate revert.
miguel: scheduling a 5m canary revert window, then promote to pool if green. Will monitor slot-ready latency and health-check success rate.
anya: customer impact summary captured: ~12 tenants saw >1% error increase; two tenants had visible streaming stalls and manual retries. CS notified and provided mitigation steps.
incident-bot: incident severity set to Sev3. Escalation: oncall will hand off in 30m. Tags: autoscale-delay, warmup-concurrency, routing-mitigation.
anya: handoff notes for next on-call: root-cause investigation ongoing (likely warmup concurrency + runtime kernel interaction). Action items: (1) revert kernel canary and observe, (2) test autoscaler parallel_warmups increase + warmup_timeout reduction, (3) enable pre-provisioning for scheduled bursts, (4) run a postmortem within 48h. /cc @taylor
miguel: opening follow-up ticket with warmup telemetry dashboard and autoscaler PR draft.
cheng: will attach logs, traces, and slot-ready latency distribution to ticket. I'll also add a short dashboard tile for slot-init failure reasons.
anya: thanks team — tracking in #incidents. I'll update status in 20m and then hand off to next shift.
